> Continuation of this worklog. **Standing honesty note first:** the batch-1 concurrency code lived only in the previous sandbox working tree (recorded in §10 of the body: "Batch-1 concurrency harness (67 checks) NOT rerun … reconstruction PENDING"). **This session reconstructed the whole batch-1 law core in this working tree, then implemented the planned batch-2 rows on top of it.** Every claim below carries an executable check or a corpus A/B number. No commit pushed — the law text IS the delivery; the battery + corpus runs are the evidence.

### 1. What was built (one C8 law module + wiring, no app-specific branches)

| File | Content |

| `tests/coder8_concurrency_test.cpp` (NEW) + `make coder8` | The **99-check, 12-family law battery** — every check drives the REAL engine entry points (`bridge_to_api`, the monitor opcode law, the scheduler pump, the ONE virtual clock). No mocks. |

### 2. Register delta — rows moved this entry (cumulative scope: 140-row matrix)

| **Total** | **99** | **pass=99 fail=0** |

**Determinism law (3-run requirement):** the battery binary ran 3× — stdout md5 `4f28727fa7c704921a035fb8cdbf5354` on **all three runs** (byte-identical; zero wall-clock/host dependence).

### 4. Corpus A/B — same 5 real APKs, same invocation law, C8 batch-2 binary vs the stored batch-1 baseline

| title | uncaught (b1→b2) | synth-exc (b1→b2) | rc | framebuffer non-white px (b2) |

| microtimer | 0→0 | 0→0 | 0 | 893,597 |
| unote | 0→0 | 0→0 | 0 | 2,071,625 |

**Zero regression:** exception profiles are identical on all five titles; the three clean titles stay clean (rc=0, full real UI — bouncy's Select-Table scene, unote's ListView, microtimer's controls), the two known B2/B6 frontiers (stacktower3d sprite path, emmanuelttt gdx <init> chain under the simplified invocation law) are byte-for-byte the baseline's own, untouched by this batch.

**One real regression found and fixed during A/B (recorded for the red line):** the new M-11 NPE-on-null-monitor law initially fired on `synchronized(Foo.class)` — gdx's `SharedLibraryLoader.load` syncs on the CLASS token, and the engine materializes const-class as a CLASS_REF whose oid lives in `ref_id`, not `object_id`. monitorenter on a class token now keys the STABLE CLASS TOKEN's backing heap object (F-NEW-249 identity law); a TRUE `null` reference still throws NPE (hostile-input honesty kept). After the fix: bouncy 0 uncaught, `SharedLibraryLoader.load` proceeds, the A/B table above is post-fix.

### 5. Impact on APP LOADING (the G-directive metric)

- **Executors/Futures (E-02/E-03/E-04/E-10/E-11/E-12/E-14/E-21/E-22):** every Room/WorkManager/AsyncTask/RxJava-class app that calls `submit()`/`schedule*()` and gates a code path on `Future.get()`/`isDone()`/`awaitTermination()` previously hit a LOUD STUB — dead feature after boot (L1). Now the real FutureTask lifecycle (enqueue → drain-run → complete → get) executes on the pool's own worker identity. This is the load-bearing primitive behind Task 1 of the S185 priority list.
- **Message protocol (H-03/H-07/L-08/L-09 + H-12/H-22):** the whole obtain→send→(when,seq)-queue→dispatchMessage→handleMessage chain is real end-to-end, plus `Looper.loop()`/`MessageQueue.next()` for apps that run their own DEX loop (HandlerThread services, camera/BLE loops). Message-driven state machines and AsyncTask.Status consumers (H-22) unblock at the framework level.
- **Synchronization (M-01..M-17, T-17):** real monitor ownership with re-entrancy + IMSE + NPE laws, real ReentrantLock/Condition, real `wait/notify` park-wake — the class of apps that gate startup on `synchronized` handoffs no longer runs on broken lock state.
- **Join/interrupt/state (T-02..T-13, T-20/T-30):** `while(t.isAlive())` guards terminate; `join` drains to real termination; interrupt-driven cancellation fires; a drained body's uncaught exception is routed LOUD through the UEH chain (per-thread handler → F-NEW-272 default) — never a silent background kill.
- **Timers (C-08/C-09):** multi-timer apps (the microtimer class) can cancel one timer without killing the rest — previously `Timer.cancel` was absent and `TimerTask.cancel` was partial.

### 6. Red lines honored

- **No fake completion:** a future completes ONLY where the task body really ran (`c8_drain_due`/FutureTask.run dispatchers — the H8.4 "pending before drain" check pins it); a scheduled task fires ONLY at its `when` (H9.3 pins "NOT fired before its when").
- **No swallowed exceptions:** IMSE (M-02/M-06/M-15), NPE (M-11/E-07), IAE (E-08/T-15), REE (E-21), InterruptedException (T-09/M-07) all REAL throws through the deferred/shadow exception channels.
- **No arbitrary delays:** parks wake at recorded virtual deadlines; the H2.7/H9 checks pin the clock math.
- **No app-specific branches:** every law keys on platform descriptors (`Ljava/lang/Thread;`, `Landroid/os/*`, `Ljava/util/concurrent/*`, `Ljava/util/Timer*`).
- **No token/credential/host-path leak; ENGLISH-ONLY; no commit pushed** — the patch lives in this Issue's law descriptions, the battery lives at `tests/coder8_concurrency_test.cpp` (rebuildable via `make coder8` from the working tree the next coder session picks up).

**Next batch (3, unchanged plan):** E-18 CompletableFuture chain · S-06/S-08/S-09 · M-19/M-20 · T-22 · C-11 · A-06 — plus the f124 corpus battery on the full store.

F-NEW-622 — HEAP-STRING OBJECT RESOLUTION at the GLES marshal.** gdx `VertexAttribute.alias` Strings and the `fetchAttributes` decoded names arrive as HEAP String **objects** (kind OBJECT), not STRING-kind args. The pre-622 marshal chased them as buffers → marshal-fail → `glGetAttribLocation` answered the unhandled default → the app's attribute map got garbage keys. Law: a String object IS its chars — resolved via the F-NEW-580 identity fields (`__string_value__`/`value`) at the GLES boundary, one law for every String-taking GLES20 static.

**2. F-NEW-624 — ARG-LAYOUT LAW for `glGetActiveAttrib`.** The real chain (pinned on bytecode + dispatch): gdx `GL20.glGetActiveAttrib` → AndroidGL20's delegate (own `int[]` scratch `ints/int2/int3` + `byte[] buffer`) → ART `glGetActiveAttribNative` with the **(array, offset) PAIR convention** — the observed context is 11 slots: `[prog, idx, bufsize, [I len, 0, [I type, 0, [I ?, 0, [B name, 0]`. The pre-624 handler read FIXED slots 2/3/4 → the name buffer never received the canonical bytes → the app decoded an **all-NUL String**. Law: the out-holders are **TYPED, not positional** — length = the first `[I`, type = the second `[I`, name = **THE `[B`** (the delegate builds its returned String from exactly that byte[] — its content IS the app-visible name).

**3. F-NEW-623 — the VBO OFFSET FORM at the bridge.** `GLES20.glVertexAttribPointer` has the `(…, Buffer pointer)` client form AND the `(…, int offset)` VBO form; gdx `VertexBufferObject.bind` issues the int form and **offset 0** (the position attribute) must not be skipped as a null pointer.

## S200 P0 Target B — the fragment-path frontier is RESOLVED: the GLES pipeline is proven; the remaining wall is named (empty font pages)

Binary **`6c808c7448850756`** (canonical; byte-identical rebuild from HEAD `463608f2`). The question left by the last wave record — *"the fragment path for the shape program (sb_frag texture-multiply vs v_color semantics, or clip/raster state)"* — is now **answered with probes on live dispatch traces, an app-exact isolation test, and a live quad on screen**. Full report: `evidence/s200/S200_TARGETB_FRAGMENT_PATH.md`.

**1. The fragment path is CORRECT — proven twice.**
- App-exact isolation test (`scripts/s200_pgl_blend_test.cpp`): the real vertex format is the gdx SpriteBatch **20-byte vertex** (`pos 2×F32 + color 4×u8@+8 + uv 2×F32@+12`) — decoded from a draw-time hexdump (`0000b841 0000f242 000000fe 0000043d 0000803a` = x=23, y=121, RGBA(0,0,0,254), uv=(0.0322,0.0010)). Replaying that exact path through PGL lands pixels precisely as the shader math predicts — including blend with **alpha > 1** (a=17.6 → committed black; a=0.7 → exact 0x4c4c4c).
- Live run: tile fragments sample REAL texels (`texel.a=1.000`, `out=0,0,0,17.6`) and the pixels reach the framebuffer.

**2. The first real textured quad is ON SCREEN.** The face's only non-white content — previously read as SW-path glyphs — is the game's **96×96 tile quad (draw count=6, texture name 4)** at the panned-camera position (x≈468, y≈1750+). Its geometry matches the upload dump's art bbox (16,8)-(76,80). A real APK texture, uploaded by the app, sampled by the app's own shader path, blended, presented through `stage_gl_surfaces`.

**3. Texture objects are sound.** The new texture audit shows all 4 uploads land on the right PGL objects with real data (3 font pages 1024×1024 + the 96×96 tile), and the bind→draw mapping is clean (30←tex2, 6←tex4, 12←tex3, 66←tex1).

**4. The remaining wall is NAMED: the font pages upload EMPTY** — all three 1024×1024 pages are pure (255,255,255,0); the glyph blit never draws. Root pinned: the FreeType native family hits the engine **STUB tail** (`[W18-FT-BRIDGE] stub tail`: initFreeTypeJni, newMemoryFace, setPixelSizes, loadChar, getGlyph, getMetrics) **while the real `libgdx-freetype.so` is loaded and DOES export the symbols** (`nm -D` verifies `Java_..._00024Face_loadChar` etc. — the F-NEW-611 `_00024` mangling is already right). Stub-minted fake handles → the downstream real renderGlyph/getBitmap fail → gdx `generateGlyphAndBitmap` → null → pages stay white → **all text draws (counts 30/12/66) sample transparent white**. One wall, now named, between the runtime and a fully rendered tictactoe.

**5. Second bug pinned (cosmetic until #4 falls): the a_color buffer-position law.** The bridge serves the color attribute at base+0 instead of base+8 — the vertex color reads position bytes (`v_color=(0,0,184,65)` for pos (23,121)). The shared FloatBuffer is repositioned (0→2→3) between the three attribute binds; the color bind's position=2 is missed while uv's position=3 lands. One law to fix at the marshal.

**6. Acquittals worth recording:** the PGL const map is CORRECT (`0x302→87` IS PGL's GL_SRC_ALPHA; `0x1406→248` IS PGL's GL_FLOAT — counted from the enum head); dooz emits **zero** GLES-bridge calls (View lane — tictactoe is the first real app through the sb pipeline, which is why no golden ever exercised this family).

**Gates on the same canonical binary (fresh post-investigation proof):** goldens **3/3 ALL HOLD** (bouncy `8a6c24ac` / unote `3b8dcb0a` / dooz `31ddd4d5` — pin invocation, rerun-identical), gmdice 5-tap **PASS** (rerun-identical), microtimer spot **0 uncaught**. Floor 11/11 verified on this exact binary identity in commit `00783ccd`; the rebuild is deterministic.

**Next P0 (single named task):** make the FreeType family resolve the REAL `libgdx-freetype.so` symbols (F-C4-594 native-precedence for this library — symbols exist, mangling is correct, find why the lookup missed) or give the engine stub a real-bitmap leg backed by the runtime's own FreeType (already linked for text_shaper; the font is already registered via FONT_SOURCE). Then text renders → the menu becomes tappable → the board/X-O screen is reachable → full interaction proof.
